overview.title: Welcome to InsightAI
overview.description: Get started with your data in 4 steps:

steps.datasets: Upload a CSV or Excel file in Datasets.
steps.quality: Check quality and clean the data inside each dataset (Quality and Cleaning tabs).
steps.semantic: Define your business metrics in Models & KPIs.
steps.ask: Ask questions in Ask AI and pin answers to a Dashboard.

organization.title: Organization settings
organization.name: Organization name
organization.timezoneHint: Used for periods such as "this month".
organization.readOnly: You can view but not change these settings.
organization.aiDataSharing: Data sent to the AI service
organization.aiDataSharingHint: The AI service ({{provider}}) processes data outside Vietnam. By default only metric definitions and the question are sent; figures and wording are produced by the system.

aiDataSharingOptions.FULL: Also result samples and data values (more natural wording)

datasets.title: Datasets
datasets.description: Upload CSV/Excel files, review their structure and browse the data.
datasets.name: Dataset name
datasets.empty: No datasets yet. Create one and upload a file to get started.
datasets.archiveConfirm: Archive dataset "{{name}}"? It will be hidden, but its data and history are kept.
datasets.noData: This dataset has no data yet. Upload a file to get started.

upload.title: Upload data
upload.hint: CSV or Excel (.xlsx), up to 100 MB, 2 million rows, 300 columns. Each upload creates a new version.

profile.failed: The data profile could not be computed.

warnings.COLUMNS_RENAMED: Some column names were normalized (lower case, no accents, unique)
warnings.EXTRA_CELLS_IGNORED: Some rows had more values than the header; extra values were ignored
warnings.INVALID_VALUES: Some values could not be converted to the column type and were stored as empty (the original value is kept)

importErrors.EMPTY_FILE: The file is empty or only has a header row.
importErrors.TOO_MANY_ROWS: The file has more than 2 million rows.
importErrors.TOO_MANY_COLUMNS: The file has more than 300 columns.
importErrors.MALFORMED_FILE: The file could not be read: it is corrupted or in the wrong format.
importErrors.UNSAFE_ARCHIVE: The Excel file expands to an unsafe size and was rejected.
importErrors.SHEET_NOT_FOUND: The requested worksheet was not found.
importErrors.UNKNOWN_COLUMN: Column type settings refer to a column that does not exist.
importErrors.INTERNAL_ERROR: A system error occurred during import. Please try again.

quality.reportHint: Every new version is checked automatically against the rules below.
quality.checkFailed: This check failed because of a system error. Run it again.
quality.issuesSample: Showing a sample of {{shown}} of {{total}} failing rows.
quality.rulesHint: They apply to every version; changes take effect at the next check.
quality.deleteConfirm: Delete the rule "{{rule}}"? Past check results are kept.

ruleHint.not_null: Every row must have a value in this column.
ruleHint.unique: The selected columns together must not repeat.
ruleHint.regex: Text values must match the pattern.
ruleHint.allowed_values: Values must be in the list.
ruleHint.range: Numbers or dates must be within the range.
ruleHint.length: The number of characters must be within the range.
ruleHint.expression: Every row must satisfy the expression (e.g. total = quantity * price).
ruleHint.foreign_key: Values must exist in a column of another dataset.

editor.name: Name
editor.rangeHint: Numbers with a decimal point (1234.5); dates as yyyy-MM-dd. One side may be empty.
editor.lengthHint: Number of characters. One side may be empty.
editor.exprHint: Use column names, comparisons, AND/OR, + − × ÷, IN, BETWEEN, IS NULL…
editor.exprNotBoolean: The expression must produce true/false (it produces {{type}}).
editor.thresholdHint: Passes when at least this % of rows are valid.
editor.fieldInvalid: {{field}}: missing or not valid, please check it.

cleaning.sourceHint: The source version is never modified; the result is a new version.
cleaning.noSuggestions: No suggestions — the data looks fine.
cleaning.noCheckYet: There is no quality check result for this version yet.

rationale.TRIM_WHITESPACE: Values in {{columns}} have leading or trailing spaces.
rationale.UNIFY_VARIANTS: {{groups}} value(s) in {{column}} are written in several ways.
rationale.PARSE_DATES: Invalid dates in {{column}} use another layout ({{formats}}).
rationale.FILL_MEDIAN: {{count}} missing value(s) in {{column}} can be filled with the median.
rationale.REMOVE_DUPLICATE_ROWS: {{count}} row(s) are copies of an earlier row.
rationale.REMOVE_DUPLICATE_KEYS: Several rows share the same {{columns}}; keep the first of each.

cleaning.recipeHint: Steps run in order. Preview to see exactly how many rows change.
cleaning.emptyRecipe: No steps yet. Add suggestions or add an operation yourself.
cleaning.applyConfirm: Create a new version from these steps? The current version is not modified and stays active until you activate the new one.
cleaning.applied: The new version was created and is being checked again.
cleaning.noChanges: These steps do not change any row.
cleaning.sampleHint: Sample of {{n}} changed rows (old values struck through, new values in green).

errors.CLEANING_FAILED: The steps could not be run on this data.
errors.INTERNAL_ERROR: Cleaning failed because of a system error. Please try again.

opHint.trim_whitespace: Remove spaces at the start and end of text values.
opHint.change_case: Change the letter case of text columns.
opHint.replace_values: Unify different spellings into one value.
opHint.fill_null: Fill empty cells with a constant or a value computed from the data.
opHint.cast_column: Read the original file values again as the new type.
opHint.parse_date: Keep valid dates, try other layouts for empty/invalid values.
opHint.drop_rows: Remove rows matching a condition or failing a rule.
opHint.deduplicate: Keep one row per group of duplicates.
opHint.rename_column: Rename a column (later steps use the new name).
opHint.drop_column: Leave the column out of the new version.

editor.noTextColumns: There is no text column at this step.
editor.collapseInner: Collapse runs of inner spaces into one
editor.mappingHint: One per line: old value => new value (empty right side clears the value).
editor.valueHint: Numbers with a decimal point; dates as yyyy-MM-dd; true/false.
editor.formatsHint: Valid dates are kept as they are.
editor.conditionHint: Rows where the expression is true are removed (unknown keeps the row).
editor.keyColumnsHint: No column selected = compare whole rows.

versions.title: Versions
versions.hint: Every version is kept. The active version is what analytics use; activate an older one to roll back.
versions.rollbackConfirm: Roll back to version {{n}}? Newer versions are kept.

semantic.title: Models & KPIs
semantic.description: Define business metrics once so every report and AI answer uses the same number.
semantic.name: Name
semantic.keyHint: Lowercase letters, digits and _; cannot change later.
semantic.keyInvalid: Use lowercase letters, digits and _, starting with a letter.
semantic.reportErrors: The model has errors and cannot be published:
semantic.reportWarnings: The model has warnings (it can still be published):

issue.DATASET_UNAVAILABLE: The source dataset is archived or has no data.
issue.TIME_DIMENSION_TYPE: A time dimension needs a date column.
issue.MEASURE_TYPE: This aggregation cannot use this data type.
issue.PRIMARY_KEY_NULL: Some rows have an empty primary key.
issue.JOIN_TYPE_MISMATCH: The join columns have different types.
issue.RELATIONSHIP_NOT_UNIQUE: The join column on the "one" side has duplicates.
issue.RELATIONSHIP_AMBIGUOUS: Several relationships connect two entities: mark exactly one as preferred.
issue.RELATIONSHIP_ORPHANS: Some rows have no match on the "one" side.
issue.RELATIONSHIP_CYCLE: Entities can be joined along several paths.
issue.DATASET_QUALITY_FAILED: The source data failed an error-level quality rule.
issue.DATA_CHECK_FAILED: A data check could not run.

semantic.publishFirst: Publish the model to query it.
semantic.entitiesHint: Each entity is a business concept backed by a dataset; its primary key sets the grain.
semantic.deleteEntityConfirm: Delete "{{entity}}" with its dimensions, measures and relationships?
semantic.expressionHint: Usually a column name; expressions work too (e.g. quantity * price).
semantic.relationshipsHint: Join a "many" entity (e.g. orders) to a "one" entity (e.g. customers). Queries only join in this direction, so nothing is counted twice.
semantic.pickMetric: Choose a metric to view or edit it.
semantic.deprecatedHint: Deprecated: not in the catalog anymore, but reports using it keep working.
semantic.metricKeyHint: Name used by queries and the AI, e.g. total_revenue.
semantic.businessDefinitionHint: Plain-language meaning: users and the AI read it.

metricTypeHint.RATIO: A metric divided by another (e.g. revenue / orders).

semantic.synonymsHint: How people call this metric (e.g. "sales"); helps the AI understand questions.

reasons.UNKNOWN_MEMBER: A member does not exist or you may not use it.
reasons.UNKNOWN_METRIC: The metric does not exist, is not published or you may not use it.
reasons.FANOUT_JOIN: This breakdown would count figures several times (one-to-many relationship).
reasons.AMBIGUOUS_JOIN_PATH: Several join paths: mark one relationship as preferred.
reasons.TIME_DIMENSION_REQUIRED: This metric has no default time dimension.
reasons.TIME_DIMENSION_AMBIGUOUS: The metrics use different time dimensions.
reasons.COMPARE_NOT_SUPPORTED: Comparing periods needs a date range and no time breakdown.
reasons.GRANULARITY_NOT_ALLOWED: The time dimension does not allow this breakdown.
reasons.DATA_UNAVAILABLE: The source data changed; validate the model again.
reasons.POLICY_NOT_ENFORCEABLE: An access policy cannot be applied.

semantic.periodHint: On the metric's default time dimension.
semantic.kpiHint: Published metrics for the chosen period, compared with the previous one.
semantic.accessHint: Restrict by role: hide metrics/dimensions or show only part of the rows. Takes effect immediately. No policy = everyone may query everything.
semantic.noPolicies: No policy: every role allowed to query sees everything.
semantic.patternHint: Comma separated: metric:key, metric:*, entity.member, entity.*
semantic.rowFilterHint: Expression on the entity's columns, e.g. region = 'North'.
semantic.publishBlocked: Not published: the model has validation errors (see below) or changed while it was checked.

ask.title: Ask AI
ask.description: Ask questions in natural language about your defined KPIs. The AI only uses published metrics; the system computes every number.
ask.deleteConfirm: Delete this conversation? This cannot be undone.
ask.intro: Ask about your KPIs, for example revenue this month by region, or compared with last month.
ask.noModel: No semantic model is published yet. Publish a model and metrics under Models & KPIs.
ask.question: Question
ask.followUpPlaceholder: Follow up, e.g. what about last month?
ask.failed: This question could not be answered. Please try again.
ask.unavailable: AI is not configured on the server (OPENAI_API_KEY is needed). Everything else works as usual.
ask.quotaReached: Your organization has used all AI questions for today. Please try again tomorrow.

errors.AI_PROVIDER_ERROR: The AI service is having trouble. Please try again later.
errors.INTERNAL_ERROR: A system error occurred while answering.
errors.AI_TIMEOUT: The answer took too long. Please try again with a more specific question.
errors.AI_REQUEST_TOO_LARGE: This question needs a larger request than the current AI plan allows, so retrying will not help. Ask a shorter question or upgrade the AI plan.

dashboards.title: Dashboards
dashboards.description: Bring metrics and AI answers together. Every viewer sees figures under their own permissions.
dashboards.name: Dashboard name
dashboards.empty: No dashboards yet. Create one, or pin an answer from Ask AI / a KPI card.
dashboards.emptyReadOnly: No dashboards have been shared with the organization yet.
dashboards.deleteConfirm: Delete dashboard "{{name}}" and all its widgets?
dashboards.noWidgets: This dashboard is empty. Pin answers from Ask AI or KPI cards (Models & KPIs) to add widgets.
dashboards.noWidgetsReadOnly: This dashboard has no widgets yet.
dashboards.definitionChangedHint: The metric has a newer version since the widget was saved; widgets always show the current version.
dashboards.filteredForYou: Figures are filtered by your access policies.
dashboards.notAvailable: This widget is not available to you (a metric or attribute is hidden or was removed).

investigations.title: Investigations
investigations.description: Describe a business problem; the AI plans an analysis, runs each step on your data and writes a report backed by evidence.
investigations.noPermission: Your role cannot run queries, so investigations are not available to you.
investigations.empty: No investigations yet. Describe a problem above to start.
investigations.createHint: Only you can see your investigations and their reports.
investigations.aiDisabled: AI is not enabled on this server.
investigations.noModel: Publish a semantic model before investigating.
investigations.goalHint: For example: why did revenue fall last month compared with the month before?
investigations.goalPlaceholder: Why did revenue fall this month?
investigations.requireApproval: Let me approve the plan before it runs
investigations.confirmDelete: Delete this investigation with its report and evidence?
investigations.planning: The AI is planning from the metric catalog (it does not see data)…

phase.AWAITING_APPROVAL: The plan is ready – review and approve it to run.
phase.RUNNING: Running the steps with your permissions.
phase.VALIDATING: Checking the hypotheses with fixed rules.
phase.PARTIAL: Some steps could not run; the report covers the rest.

errors.PLAN_INVALID: The AI could not produce a valid plan for the metric catalog.
errors.PLAN_NOT_POSSIBLE: This problem cannot be investigated with the available metrics.
errors.AI_PROVIDER_ERROR: The AI service failed. Please try again later.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You can no longer run queries in this organization.
errors.MODEL_CHANGED: The model or a metric got a new version during the run; it stopped so definitions are not mixed.
errors.BUDGET_EXCEEDED: The budget (time or queries) ran out.
errors.DEPENDENCY_FAILED: a step it depends on did not run
errors.AI_REQUEST_TOO_LARGE: The request to the AI service is larger than the current plan allows (e.g. a free tier's tokens-per-minute limit), so retrying will not help. Upgrade the plan or switch AI provider.

report.title: Report

renderer.llm: Worded by AI, every figure taken from the evidence

report.noFindings: No finding is backed by enough evidence.
report.suggestion: Suggestions – check with the business before acting.
